text:
When hydrated copper(II) sulfate is heated, it produces white copper(II) sulfate. When water is
added, the white copper(II) sulfate turns blue.
Which type of reaction is shown by these observations?
A
decomposition
B
displacement
C
redox
D
reversible
subject: Chemistry
